turns.text: In September 2026, the cost per acquisition (cost per booking / CPA) for the **Search** channel was **€124.84**, based on a total ad spend of **€3,870.00** and **31 bookings**.

args.sql:
WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend AS
  (SELECT SUM(a.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS a
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     bookings AS
  (SELECT COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE b.booked_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' )
SELECT spend.total_spend AS total_spend_eur,
       bookings.total_bookings,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(spend.total_spend, bookings.total_bookings), 2) AS cost_per_booking_eur
FROM spend
CROSS JOIN bookings
